```{r data_import, echo = FALSE}

                                     levels = c("T0","T1","3DBS", "11DAS",

```{r data_sets, echo=FALSE, include = FALSE}
N1P2K2_rhizo<- Full_data %>% amp_subset_samples(Zone %in% "Root") %>% amp_subset_samples(Fertilizer %in% "N1P2K2")
M1P1_rhizo<-Full_data %>% amp_subset_samples(Zone %in% "Root") %>% amp_subset_samples(Fertilizer %in% "M1P1")
N1K1_rhizo<-Full_data %>% amp_subset_samples(Zone %in% "Root") %>% amp_subset_samples(Fertilizer %in% "N1K1")
Soil_only<-Full_data %>% amp_subset_samples(Zone %in% "BulkSoil") 
```

```{r rarefaction_curves_1, fig.dim = c(8,6), echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Fig. S2. Rarefaction curves of the M1P1 (a), N1K1 (b) and N1P2K2 (c) rhizosphere samples."}
M1P1_rare<-M1P1_rhizo %>% amp_rarefaction_curve(facet_by = "Time",color_by = "Inoculum.")+ylab("Number of observed ASVs")
N1K1_rare<-N1K1_rhizo %>% amp_rarefaction_curve(facet_by = "Time",color_by = "Inoculum.")+ylab("Number of observed ASVs")
N1P2K2_rare<-N1P2K2_rhizo %>% amp_rarefaction_curve(facet_by = "Time",color_by = "Inoculum.")+ylab("Number of observed ASVs")
ggarrange(M1P1_rare,N1K1_rare,N1P2K2_rare, labels = c("A","B","B"))
```

```{r rarefaction_curves,fig.dim = c(8,6), echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Fig. S3. Rarefaction curves of soil communities."}
Soil_only %>% amp_rarefaction_curve(facet_by = "Time",color_by = "Fertilizer")+ylab("Number of observed ASVs")
```

```{r alpha_div, cache =TRUE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,fig.dim = c(9,6), fig.cap = "Fig. S4. Shannon diversity across [FB21.1]the growth season for bulk soil (To, T1, 3 DBS) and rhizosphere communities. Each point represents a sample." }
phyl_ob<-readRDS("Input_files/Filtered_phyloseq25.rds")

sample_data(phyl_ob)$Time<-factor(sample_data(phyl_ob)$Time, 
                                     levels = c("T0","T1","3DBS", "11DAS",
                                                "14DAS","17DAS","31DAS",
                                                "158DAS","187DAS","215DAS",
                                                "227DAS","256DAS","318DAS"))


#First rarefy 100 times and take the average
## Create a matrix with all the samples as rows and 100 empty columns
shan_ra<-matrix(NA,nsamples(phyl_ob),100)

# Then rarefy once and then calculate  Shannon diversity, repeat 100 times. Do not set rngseed as the values will the be the same
#Do not set seed, otherwise it will be the same every time
for(i in 1:100){
  {Full16_rare<-rarefy_even_depth(phyl_ob, sample.size = min(sample_sums(phyl_ob)))
  Shannon<-plot_richness(Full16_rare ,x = "Sample_ID", measures = "Shannon")
    shan_ra[,i]<-Shannon$data$value}
}
#Calculate mean of the 100 rarefied Shannon indices
shan_ra_me<-apply(shan_ra,MARGIN =  1, mean)

shan_mean_met<-cbind(sample_data(phyl_ob),Shannon =shan_ra_me)
unique(shan_mean_met$Time)
#  Plot the data
#shan_mean_met$Plot_var<-paste(shan_mean_met$Variety,shan_mean_met$Treatment, sep = "_")

Shann_plot_all_points<-shan_mean_met %>% 
  #filter(!Treatment %in% "Mock" & !Compartment %in% "Mock") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Shannon, color = Fertilizer))+
  geom_point(position =position_dodge(width = 0.4))+theme_bw()+
  labs(color = "Sample")+theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Shann_plot_all_points

```



```{r PCoA_soil_rhizo, cache = TRUE,echo = FALSE, fig.dim = c(6,6), fig.cap = "Fig. S5. PCoA of soil and rhizosphere bacterial communities using Bray Curtis dissimilarities on non-rarefied data."}

physeq_ord_<-ordinate(phyl_ob, method = "PCoA",distance = "bray")
p3<-plot_ordination(phyl_ob,physeq_ord_, shape = "Fertilizer", color = "Zone")

p3 + guides(shape = guide_legend(title ="Fertility Level"))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "right", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background =  element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color = "white"))


```




```{r Heatmap_phyla, fig.dim = c(10,5), echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Fig. S6.  The 10 most abundant phyla in the rhizosphere microbiome across the entire growth season. The values are mean relative abundances (n = 16)."}
Full_data %>% amp_subset_samples(Zone %in% "Root") %>%
  amp_heatmap(facet_by = "Time", group_by = "Fertilizer", tax_aggregate = "Phylum", tax_show = 10)

```

```

```



```{r Heatmap_3, fig.dim = c(10,10),echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Fig. S9. Relative abundances of the 15 most abundant genera across the 10 sampling times at the N1K1 fertility level (n = 16)."}
N1K1_rhizo %>% amp_heatmap(facet_by = "Time", group_by = "Time",tax_aggregate = "Genus", tax_show = 15)

*Insert PCoA of rarefied data AND PCoA/tSNE of non-rarefied data to complement fig 4.*

```{r permanova, echo = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
phyl_ob<-readRDS("Input_files/Filtered_phyloseq25.rds")

rhizo_phyl<-subset_samples(phyl_ob, Zone %in% "Root" )
ASV_table<-data.frame((otu_table(rhizo_phyl))) # samples as rows

rhizo_dist_av<-avgdist(ASV_table, meanfun = "mean", dmethod = "bray", sample = min(sample_sums(rhizo_phyl)))


sample_data(rhizo_phyl)$Block<-sapply(strsplit(sample_data(rhizo_phyl)$Sample,"\\."),'[',2)
h1 <- with(data.frame(sample_data(rhizo_phyl)), how(nperm = 999, blocks = Block)) # Accounting for block effect
set.seed(5)
model<-adonis2(rhizo_dist_av~Time*Fertilizer*Inoculum., data = data.frame(sample_data(rhizo_phyl)), by = "terms", permutations = h1)

knitr::kable(model)

```
